enriched_activities.desc: Lies in bed. Closes eyes. Pulls blanket over body. Turns to left side. Adjusts pillow. Bends knees. Straightens legs. Turns to right side. Moves arm under pillow. Remains still. Breathes regularly. Turns to back. Sighs. Continues sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth and showering
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on bathroom light. Turns on tap. Washes face. Picks up toothbrush. Applies toothpaste. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Turns on shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Rinses body. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Hangs towel. Turns off light. Leaves bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast, making coffee with the kettle
enriched_activities.desc: Enters kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and bread. Closes refrigerator. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Fries eggs. Places bread in toaster. Presses lever. Takes plate. Puts food on plate. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Fills kettle with water. Turns on kettle. Pours water into mug. Drinks coffee. Washes dishes. Turns off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work uniform and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Opens closet. Takes out uniform. Closes closet. Takes off pajamas. Puts on uniform shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Opens drawer. Takes out badge. Puts badge in pocket. Takes bag from chair. Opens bag. Puts stethoscope in bag. Puts notebook in bag. Zips bag. Puts bag by door. Checks phone. Turns off light. Leaves bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the day shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Looks out window. Gets off bus. Walks to hospital. Enters hospital. Walks to locker room. Changes into work shoes. Puts bag in locker. Walks to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Checks patient charts. Talks to patient. Takes vital signs. Administers medication. Updates records. Consults with doctor. Assists with procedure. Answers phone. Talks to colleague. Walks to supply room. Restocks supplies. Washes hands. Talks to patient family. Sits at desk. Types notes.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a lunch break at work
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to cafeteria. Picks up tray. Selects food. Pays for food. Finds table. Sits down. Eats food. Drinks water. Checks phone. Talks to colleague. Clears tray. Throws trash. Walks back to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing clinical work, patient care and charting
enriched_activities.desc: Checks patient vitals. Administers medication. Assists patient with mobility. Changes bandage. Talks to patient. Updates chart. Consults with nurse. Answers call light. Walks to patient room. Adjusts IV. Documents care. Talks to doctor. Attends meeting. Types notes. Washes hands.
Walks to bus stop. Waits for bus. Boards bus. Taps card. Finds seat. Sits down. Reads book. Gets off bus. Walks home. Enters house. Removes shoes. Hangs coat. Walks to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking dinner with the induction cooker and eating
enriched_activities.desc: Turns on kitchen light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Places induction cooker on counter. Plugs in induction cooker. Turns on induction cooker. Puts pan on cooker. Pours oil into pan. Chops vegetables. Adds vegetables and chicken to pan. Stirs with spatula. Adds spices. Cooks. Turns off induction cooker. Takes plate. Serves food. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Drinks water.

enriched_activities.activity: Clearing the table and loading the dishwasher
enriched_activities.desc: Stands up from table. Picks up plates. Scrapes food into trash. Rinses plates. Opens dishwasher. Places plates in dishwasher. Picks up glasses. Places glasses in dishwasher. Picks up utensils. Places utensils in dishwasher. Adds dishwasher detergent. Closes dishwasher. Turns on dishwasher. Wipes table with cloth. Wipes counters. Turns off kitchen light. Leaves kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa and watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Enters living room. Turns on light. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Sits on sofa. Changes channel. Watches TV. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Adjusts blanket. Watches TV. Stands up. Gets snack. Returns to sofa. Sits down. Continues watching TV. Turns off TV. Turns off light. Leaves living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Taking a shower and drying hair
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on shower. Steps into shower. Washes body. Washes hair. Rinses. Turns off shower. Steps out. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Hangs towel. Turns off light. Leaves bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down, checking phone and reading in bed
enriched_activities.desc: Enters bedroom. Turns on light. Takes off clothes. Puts on pajamas. Lies on bed. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Scrolls through apps. Puts down phone. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads. Turns page. Reads. Closes book. Puts book on nightstand. Turns off light. Lies down. Closes eyes.

Lies in bed. Eyes closed. Pulls blanket up. Turns to side. Adjusts pillow. Remains asleep. Breathes regularly. Turns to other side. Moves arm. Remains still. Continues sleeping. Bends knees. Straightens legs. Sighs.
